settings.wrap_rule: A matched angle sample is called "wrapped" when the training value is more than 90 degrees away from the LocoHub value AND the difference (training minus LocoHub) is within 20 degrees of a multiple of 180 degrees. Multiples that are even (0, 360, 720 ...) are "whole-turn wraps"; odd multiples (180, 540 ...) are "half-turn flips". Corrected value = training value minus that multiple of 180 degrees. Both numbers (90 and 20) were fixed in advance, not tuned. Velocity: the ankle-angle wrap flags are widened by 2 samples on each side and velocity samples inside the widened flags are left out (neighbours are neighbours in the compared sample order; for UM21 this also reaches across stride joins).
